svg.title: Missionaries and Cannibals search tree (BFS)
svg.text: Complete search tree: 33 of 49 nodes drawn; the other 16 are repeated-state leaves (duplicates), left out for readability.
BFS search: 49 nodes generated, 14 expanded, goal at depth 11.
number = order in which the search expanded the node
Node [m, c, b]: m, c = missionaries and cannibals on the left bank;
b = 1: boat on the left bank, b = 0: boat on the right bank.
Edge [x y d]: x missionaries and y cannibals cross; d = 1 to the right bank, d = -1 to the left bank.
